title: Firebase Android app registration — Middo Kitchen + Middo Delivery
purpose: Exact details to register two new Android apps in the existing Middo Firebase project so kitchen and delivery Flutter/APK clients can use FCM like corporate.

server_fcm.note: One service account covers all Android apps in this project. Do not create a second Firebase project.

apps_to_register.sha1_debug_optional: Add debug SHA-1 later if you need Google Sign-In / Dynamic Links; FCM-only does not require it for basic token delivery.
push_use_cases_planned: Complaint / SLA warnings (today StaffAlerts are in-app DB only)
backend_gaps: No kitchen FCM send pipeline yet

apps_to_register.naming_note: User-facing PWA is Middo Rider (public/manifest-delivery.webmanifest). Package uses com.middo.delivery to match the /delivery role path; store listing can still show Middo Rider.
apps_to_register.sha1_debug_optional: Same as kitchen — optional for FCM-only.
push_use_cases_planned: New claimable runs / kitchen→ops box returns
backend_gaps: No delivery FCM send pipeline yet

console_checklist: Under Your apps → Add app → Android
Register Middo Kitchen with Android package name exactly: com.middo.kitchen
Download google-services.json → keep for mobile/kitchen/android/app/ when the Flutter app exists
Register Middo Delivery with Android package name exactly: com.middo.delivery
Download that google-services.json → keep for mobile/delivery/android/app/
Confirm Project settings still shows three Android apps: com.middo.corporates, com.middo.kitchen, com.middo.delivery
Server: ensure storage/app/firebase/service-account.json exists on the deploy host and FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=middo-55888 (no new service account required)
do_not: Do not create a separate Firebase project per app
Do not reuse com.middo.corporates google-services.json inside kitchen/delivery APKs
Do not commit service-account.json or raw API keys to git
Do not change corporate package name

save_locally: Store downloaded JSONs outside git if Flutter folders are not created yet, e.g. Desktop/Workplace/middo-firebase/kitchen-google-services.json and delivery-google-services.json
Or create mobile/kitchen and mobile/delivery scaffolds next and drop files into android/app/
